setup.title: Connect Search Console and GA4
setup.body: To see the SEO of your website and your clients' sites here, GNERAI OS needs to be registered in Google Cloud just once.

project.title: A Google Cloud project
project.body: Enable the Google Search Console API, the Google Analytics Data API and the Google Analytics Admin API.

consent.title: Internal consent screen
consent.body: Of the “Internal” type (Google Workspace): it doesn't need verification, and access doesn't expire after 7 days.

client.title: A web application OAuth client ID

env.title: Three environment variables on the server
env.body: The client ID and secret, and a key to encrypt the tokens (openssl rand -base64 32). Then restart the app.

setup.demo: In the meantime, you can see how it looks with sample data in the <link>demo org</link>.

connect.title: Connect your Google account
connect.body: An owner connects, once, the account that has access to Search Console and Analytics for your website and your clients' sites. After that, it syncs every day.

reconnect.title: Reconnect Google
reconnect.body: Google has stopped granting access (the permission was revoked or has expired). Reconnect to keep syncing.

search.title: Clicks, impressions and position
search.body: From Search Console, day by day, with 16 months of history.

traffic.title: Sessions and conversions
traffic.body: From GA4, for organic traffic and the total.

opportunities.title: Quick wins
opportunities.body: Queries one step away from the top 3, and the ones rising or falling.

business.title: SEO → business
business.body: Leads, clients won and revenue that come through SEO.

connect.readOnly: Read-only: GNERAI OS can't change anything in Google.
connect.ownerOnly: Ask an owner of the organization to connect Google.
